Local bare publish remote seeded with the initial commit. agent.txt changed; other.txt has an unrelated pre-existing edit.
procedures.isolation: Temporary HOME/CODEX_HOME/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/XDG/TMPDIR; Git personal/system config disabled. Auth copy only in temporary OpenCode home. Pure mode and deny-by-default tools with read/skill, Git inspection/add/commit/push and exact helper invocation enabled; external_directory denied. No remote network push or raw stderr retained.
